name: Endeavour Group Limited
summary: Endeavour Group Limited engages in the liquor retail and hospitality businesses in Australia and New Zealand. It operates in Retail and Hotels segments. The Retail segment procures, manufactures, and sells drinks. The Hotels segment provides hotels-related goods and services, such as food and drinks, accommodation, entertainment, and gaming. The company operates under the Dan Murphy's, BWS, ALH Hotels, Pinnacle Drinks, LANGTONS, MixIn, and FULFILLED brands. Endeavour Group Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Barangaroo, Australia.
